notes.title: Triangle Strategy вышла на PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X|S — больше не консольный эксклюзив Nintendo Switch
notes.notes: Triangle Strategy, ранее вышедшая на Nintendo Switch, PC (Steam) и семействе гарнитур виртуальной реальности Quest, добралась до PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X|S. Компания Square Enix представила анонсирующий трейлер и сразу отправила игру в релиз.

notes.title: Pre-purchase FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles Now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004640/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9108781/0028b7f4e30f7ec79653ea57ab36391aafa576ca.jpg[/img]

Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

notes.notes:

Save 60% on TRIANGLE STRATEGY!
Offer ends 4 December (6:00 pm UTC)

Enjoy this message from Producer Yasuaki Arai!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946804/b81725829a9af2b4312f8fc83fe7717e16e01d30.png[/img]
[h3]**About This Game**[/h3]
TRIANGLE STRATEGY is a tactics RPG that features HD-2D graphics, that combines 2D pixel art sprites with 3D environments.
Players can enjoy immersive turn-based battles set in the war-torn land of Norzelia.

[h3]**Message for First-Time Players of TRIANGLE STRATEGY**[/h3]
In this game, there are a total of 30 playable characters. Depending on your choices, different companions will become available for you to team up with, allowing you to create your own favourite party and experiment with various combinations in battles. 

This game also features multiple endings, with the story branching off based on your own choices. In your first playthrough, it is recommend that you enjoy the story without looking at walkthroughs or guides, leaving the choices entirely up to you. Then, if you play a second or third time, you will be able to discover new stories and completely different endings.

notes.title: Square Enix продолжит создавать ремейки в формате HD-2D, расширяя границы инновационного визуального стиля
notes.notes: В недавнем интервью Digital Trends продюсер Square Enix Масааки Хаясака затронул тему переизданий в в формате HD-2D — визуальном стиле, который полюбился фанатам Octopath Traveler. В скором времени состоится релиз Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, и японский издатель не собирается останавливаться на достигнутом.

notes.title: TRIANGLE STRATEGY is available now!
notes.notes:
An epic tale, brought to life with stunning HD-2D graphics, the player will be pressed to make difficult decisions in this story set against a backdrop of the war-torn continent of Norzelia.

Three mighty powers have long waged war on the great continent of Norzelia. 

This land bears a long and scarred history that includes the Saltiron War, a war that erupted over control of salt and iron resources. A balance of power has been achieved between the Holy State of Hyzante, which controls the salt, the Grand Dutchy of Aesfrost, a land of iron clad in frost and snow, and the forested Kingdom of Glenbook, which lies nestled between the other two powers.

However, a certain incident shakes the balance between these three powers, which then begins to crumble away...

[h3]DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION[/h3]
This product is a Digital Deluxe Edition, a bundle that contains the game and the TRIANGLE STRATEGY Mini-Artbook (digital download).
(The TRIANGLE STRATEGY Mini-Artbook (digital download) is an abridged version of TRIANGLE STRATEGY Design Works THE ART OF TRIANGLE 2018-2022. It comprises of 21 pages, including character sketches of the eight members of the Wolffort house and a collection of pixel art.)

[h3]『TRIANGLE STRATEGY DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION』+『VARIOUS DAYLIFE』Bundle[/h3]
To commemorate the release of TRIANGLE STRATEGY and VARIOUS DAYLIFE, the two games are now available as a bundle!

notes.title: Triangle Strategy comes to PC next month as our strategy RPG cup overfloweth
notes.notes: Triangle Strategy, Square Enix's first brand new stab at the strategy RPG in years, is about to land on PC where it belongs. Square announced on Tuesday that the turn-based tactics game hits Steam on October 13, sandwiching it right in the middle of two other fairly similar games from Square. At the end of this month it's launching real time tactics game The DioField Chronicle, and then in November we're getting the remastered Tactics Ogre: Reborn. If you're a glutton for number-crunching, grid-based Japanese RPGs, you are eating good this fall... Read more.
